archiveTitle: Daily Brief | Path of Exile 2 reveals the Shadow class and Acts 5 and 6

entries.headline: Where Winds Meet Anniversary Version Hutuo launches on Xbox on November 13
entries.summary: Xbox Wire says Anniversary Version Hutuo launches for Xbox Series X|S on November 13. Players will enter a war zone shaped by a 16-year conflict and join the frontline defense at Zhongdu Bridge.
entries.verification: Xbox Wire is a first-party developer post and explicitly provides the version name, date, Xbox platform, and narrative scope.
entries.timeNote: Xbox Wire lists publication at 17:00 UTC on November 6, 2026.
entries.releaseTypeLabel: Anniversary update and Hutuo region launch

entries.headline: Report: PIF and Silver Lake held acquisition talks with Unity
entries.summary: AUTOMATON, citing Reuters and anonymous sources, reports that a consortium including PIF and Silver Lake approached Unity Software about an acquisition at a valuation of about $25 billion. Unity is reportedly still evaluating its options.
entries.verification: The fixed packet contains only AUTOMATON’s relay of a Reuters report based on anonymous sources, so the contact and any transaction remain unconfirmed.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON lists publication at 02:41:50 UTC on November 6, 2026.

entries.headline: Certified German course lets 60 people apply for three days of study leave around Grand Theft Auto VI
entries.summary: IGN reports that the certified course Open World Games: Lessons from a Digital World is open to 60 participants from November 18 to 20 and uses open-world games to examine storytelling, digital culture, and collaboration. Eligible participants may use three days of paid educational leave.
entries.verification: IGN identifies this as a certified German educational-leave course and specifies the participant cap, dates, and eligibility context; it is not presented as leave available to every German player.
entries.timeNote: The fixed IGN evidence records publication at 20:18:07 UTC on November 6, 2026.

entries.headline: Natsu no Kanata: PROLOGUE launches free on Steam on December 15
entries.summary: Kawade Shobo Shinsha announced the visual novel Natsu no Kanata: PROLOGUE, created by Kazuhide Oka. It adapts the opening of the Natsu no Kanata novel into playable form and is scheduled to launch free on Steam on December 15.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report provides the publisher, creator, adaptation scope, Steam platform, free distribution, and December 15 date.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON lists publication at 04:55:55 UTC on November 6, 2026.

entries.headline: Nexon announces TALESWEAVER MOBILE and opens Korean focus-group registration
entries.summary: Nexon announced TALESWEAVER MOBILE, a new MMORPG based on the TalesWeaver IP and developed by NEXON Korea Corporation. Registration for a focus-group test is open in South Korea.
entries.verification: The AUTOMATON report distinguishes the announced game, its developer, and the Korean test-registration scope. No unannounced platform is inferred.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON lists publication at 05:34:56 UTC on November 6, 2026.

entries.headline: Ratchet & Clank: Ranger Rumble ends development; servers close in May 2027
entries.summary: Sony Interactive Entertainment and Oh BiBi announced that development of Ratchet & Clank: Ranger Rumble is ending. A final update arrived on November 6, the game will leave storefronts on November 21, and servers are scheduled to close on May 1, 2027.
entries.verification: Gematsu relays the publisher, developer, and official website announcement, including the final-update, delisting, and shutdown dates.
entries.timeNote: Gematsu lists publication at 15:01 UTC on November 6, 2026.
entries.releaseTypeLabel: Development halt, delisting, and server shutdown

entries.headline: Wuthering Waves Version 3.8, Lilies in a Dying Dream, launches November 12
entries.summary: Gematsu relays Kuro Games’ announcement that Wuthering Waves Version 3.8, Lilies in a Dying Dream, will launch on November 12.
entries.verification: Gematsu explicitly attributes the version name and November 12 date to developer Kuro Games. No additional update content is added beyond the fixed evidence.
entries.timeNote: Gematsu lists publication at 12:00:07 UTC on November 6, 2026.

entries.headline: VR co-op shooter PAYDAY: Aces High is now available
entries.summary: Fast Travel Games released PAYDAY: Aces High on November 6. The bank-heist crime FPS is built exclusively for VR and supports cooperative play for up to four players.
entries.verification: 4Gamer identifies Fast Travel Games, the November 6 release, the VR-only format, and support for up to four players.
entries.timeNote: The fixed 4Gamer evidence records publication at 06:19:35 UTC on November 6, 2026.

entries.headline: Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School launched on November 6
entries.summary: iam8bit Presents released Coin Crew Games’ Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School on November 6. Players explore an open-world school and take on a range of escape-room puzzles.
entries.verification: 4Gamer supports the release date, publisher, developer, and open-world school puzzle premise. The fixed evidence does not support inferring platforms.
entries.timeNote: The fixed 4Gamer evidence records publication at 12:32:24 UTC on November 6, 2026.

entries.headline: Path of Exile 2 full release adds the Shadow class and Acts 5 and 6
entries.summary: Grinding Gear Games revealed at ExileCon 2026 that Path of Exile 2’s full release will add the Shadow class, the Assassin and Infiltrator ascendancies, daggers, and Acts 5 and 6. Full release and the move to free-to-play are set for December 12.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON’s event report attributes the classes, ascendancies, weapon, Acts 5 and 6, and December 12 full-release date to the ExileCon 2026 developer presentation.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON lists publication at 00:20 UTC on November 7, 2026.
